name: Command Press
tagline: Blueprint/engineering-drawing editorial for skill & command roundups.
whenToUse: Skill / command roundups (/dumbify, /storytelling, …) — one slide per skill
N-skills / N-steps explainers where each item is a named command
Before/after, audit, or 'I turned this into a skill' content
Big grouped lists (20–36 skills / MCPs / plugins in 4–6 layers): layout 'atlas', style S22

fonts.headline: Anton (Google) — heavy condensed grotesque, all-caps, slash-prefixed

palette.chrome: rgba(14,14,14,.5) ink — structural: grid, dimension line, frame, FIG/SHEET labels

rules.colorDiscipline: Orange = 'look here' only (callouts, good-line, corner marks). Structure stays ink. Never let orange do double duty.
rules.charts: Two-tone: primary/good line = terracotta, secondary/bad line = ink dashed. Never all-orange.
rules.headline: Auto-fits width up to head-size; long names bleed to the right edge deliberately.
rules.heroes: Body-slide heroes are HTML, never AI-gen. Only the cover (and S10 FIG drawings) may be Codex plates.

files.slides.html: copy to carousel root, edit slides[] at bottom
files.preview-atlas.png: atlas layout look reference (index, 2 layers, combo, CTA; dashed mascot placeholders)

layouts.default: command sheet: one named command per slide, hero.type below
layouts.atlas: layout:'atlas' (S22 Layered Parts Atlas): atlas.kind layer | index | combo | cta; deck facts in const ATLAS {label, total}; spec in recipe.md 'atlas layout'
